title: Contact-Centre Call QA & Summarisation

blueprintSignals.name: Disclosure detection
blueprintSignals.definition: detected spans for each required statement, with confidence
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Speech recognition errors cause misses, so use fuzzy matching

blueprintSignals.name: Summary faithfulness
blueprintSignals.definition: share of summary claims supported by the transcript
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Needs an entailment check, not only overlap

blueprintSignals.name: Sentiment shift
blueprintSignals.definition: change in sentiment between the first and last minute of the call
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Weak and noisy, so use with other signals

blueprintSignals.name: Silence and talk ratio
blueprintSignals.definition: share of the call that is dead air and agent-to-customer talk ratio
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Noisy, as silence is often legitimate

label: For "Contact-Centre Call QA & Summarisation": Transcribe, summarise and score calls against the quality and compliance checklist so supervisors review the right calls and agents spend less time on notes. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Supervisor labels are inconsistent between reviewers, so the ceiling is lower than it appears.
